theme: Peak-summer Kashmir - Srinagar's gardens in full bloom, Gulmarg's hills green under a running gondola, the Dal calm and cool at dawn
season: Peak summer (early July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra runs 2 July to 17 August, so the valley is busy and fully open. Flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel clear, Mughal gardens at full bloom, Chinars in full leaf, Gulmarg green with both gondola phases running, and the Dal glass-still and cool at dawn (Srinagar ~15-30C).
campaign_name: Kashmir Gardens in bloom, Gulmarg green [INR] - 05 Jul 2026
subject: Gardens in bloom and Gulmarg gone green
